You say:
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Sent · Just now

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

Yes, damaged or faulty items are handled differently from standard change-of-mind returns.

For standard returns, items must be in original, unwashed condition with all tags attached. Online orders can be returned within 30 days of delivery using a free prepaid courier label. In-store purchases can be refunded within 14 days, or exchanged/credited within 30 days. Online returns can also be processed through the returns portal by entering your order details and following the prompts.

Faulty or damaged items are assessed separately. If your item is faulty or arrives damaged, please take it to a Barkers store or contact Customer Care by email at customer.services@barkersonline.co.nz or phone 09 304 2776. Barkers will review the issue and may offer a repair, replacement, refund, or store credit, depending on the situation.

In summary, standard returns follow specific return windows and condition requirements, while faulty or damaged items are reviewed individually for the appropriate resolution.
